item.name: POST Start or resume quiz attempt

exec: pm.test("Attempt started or resumed", function () { pm.expect([200, 201]).to.include(pm.response.code); pm.collectionVariables.set("quizAttemptId", pm.response.json().data.id); });

pm.test("Quiz graded", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.data.attempt.status).to.eql("SUBMITTED"); pm.expect(body.data.result.maxScore).to.eql(5.5); });
pm.test("Quiz delete accepted", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(202); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql(""); });

request.description: Business flow: docs/business-flows/media/post-media-direct.md. Upload to MinIO is manual: choose a real file, calculate exact size/SHA-256, then submit every returned signed field plus the file directly to uploadUrl. Never save policy/signature/form fields in the collection or environment. Intent creation is non-idempotent.

exec: pm.test("Returns items matching status filter", function () { pm.expect(payload.data.items).to.be.an("array"); payload.data.items.forEach(function (item) { pm.expect(item.status).to.eql("READY"); pm.expect(item.contentUrl).to.contain("/content"); }); });

request.description: Business flow: docs/business-flows/media/get-media-library.md. Filter optional status with PENDING, READY or FAILED; only READY media is selectable for usage and Markdown.
Business flow: docs/business-flows/media/post-media-direct.md. Run only after the manual signed MinIO POST succeeds. This request is safe to retry with the same mediaId.
Business flow: docs/business-flows/media/post-media-usages.md. Direct usage must reference original media; thumbnail derivation is Worker-only.
Only succeeds after the thumbnail job reaches FAILED. API contract: docs/api/media-service/endpoints/post-media-thumbnail-retry.md
